cause_quote: The diff attaches `source: "channel-owner"` to `createCronCreatorAuthorityCapability(authorityRunId, ...)`, while `bindCronManagementGrant` rejects a scope when `scope.runId !== runId`, so the ingress entitlement cannot serve the queued run.
user_saw: An authenticated channel owner who asked for the automation inventory in a queued message saw only the current conversation’s jobs.
summary: The fix carries a source-bound authority factory through the followup and collect queues so eligible owner messages can establish a fresh automation management scope when they run.
reasoning: The introducing diff extends gateway-wide management from authenticated Control UI administrators to configured channel owners. At that commit, the ingress wrapper already revoked its capability when the immediate call settled, and the existing queue drained later without recreating that capability for the new run. Queued owner messages therefore lacked gateway-wide management from the first version of the feature.
